{{Attr|Freeze}} |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|The Void's Gaze}}''' - Fires at a tower or unit in its range of 22.5 but not in its minimal range of 7.5, creating an explosion with a radius of 4 that stuns towers for 3 seconds and deals 200 damage to units. |ability1_cooldown = 4-5 }} ==Description== The '''Void Eye''' is an enemy that appears in [[Hardcore Mode]] and the [[Voidcore Mode]]. The '''Void Eye''' is primarily summoned by the [[Void Reaver]] and the [[Soul Stealer]], it does not appear naturally in either of the two modes. The '''Void Eye''' has a decent amount of health and moves at such a slow speed it is practically immobile. It will fire a projectile every 4-5 seconds at a tower or unit that crates an explosion with a radius of 4, stunning towers for 3 seconds and dealing 200 damage to units. ==Logbook Description== "''The Void Eyes are pulled from what were once creatures that roamed the Void. Even now, there are many things that have bloomed within the darkness after realms have found their peace. Nothing is left to waste, and some of the more valuable parts are turned into pieces of the Void Caster’s army. When they aren’t attacking, they weep quietly to themselves, hidden off in a corner until they are needed again.''" ==Appearance== The '''Void eye''' is a floating purple eyeball with a black eye socket as its body. Around it is a purple-like effect and in its center it has a black elliptical pupil. ==Strategy== *To prevent the '''Void Eye''' from stunning towers, you can set high DPS towers, such as the [[Juggernaut]] to ''Weakest'' or to ''Last Enemy'' to deal with them. *Towers such as the [[Farm]] can be used to bait their attacks. **Despite stunning towers, the '''Void Eye''' will actually target towers immune to stuns, allowing practically any tower to be used for this purpose. *The [[Mercenary Base]]'s ''Air-Drop'' ability with the units all set to [[Riot Guard]] can be used by sending the units directly at the '''Void Eye'''. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|{{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Hardcore Rework Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Void Eye''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} VoidEyeIconIG.png|'''Void Eye''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Void Eye''' is most likely based on the Roblox accessory, the {{RLinkC|3210204459|The Hematite Eye}}. *Excluding immobile enemies, the '''Void Eye''' is the slowest enemy in the game, as it is ten times slower than the [[Ice Beacon]]. *The '''Void Eye''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Void Eye''' added. *'''17 July 2026''' - [[v2.3.0]] **Health decreased from 20,000 to 15,000 in [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode. {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Hardcore]] [[Category:Voidcore]]
